title: Truebred
summary: TRUEBRED, adjective [true and bred.] Of a genuine or right breed; as a truebred beast. 1. Being of genuine breeding or education; as a truebred gentleman.

inlines.v: TRUEBRED, adjective [true and bred.] Of a genuine or right breed; as a truebred beast. 1. Being of genuine breeding or education; as a truebred gentleman.
